events.title: "Home for the Holidays" Tree Lighting
events.addr: W Genesee St & S Salina St, Syracuse, NY 13202
events.blurb: The city lights its 42-foot tree with a choir and figure skaters, then the Clinton Square ice rink stays open until 9:30 p.m.

events.title: Les Misérables
events.blurb: A new staging of the musical from Syracuse Stage and SU Drama opens Friday and runs through January 3.

events.title: Syracuse Crunch vs. Laval Rocket
events.blurb: Saturday night AHL hockey at the War Memorial.

events.title: Jessimae Peluso
events.venue: Funny Bone Comedy Club, Destiny USA
events.blurb: Stand-up from the Syracuse-born comedian, with three shows over two nights. Fees are included in the price.

events.title: Dickens Christmas in Skaneateles
events.blurb: Opens Friday with the World's Smallest Christmas Parade at noon; carolers, roasted chestnuts and performances fill the village Saturday and Sunday. Free parking and shuttle.

events.title: Holiday Night Market
events.blurb: Dozens of Central New York makers, food and drinks for Small Business Saturday shopping.

events.title: Syracuse Ugly Sweater 5K
events.blurb: Run or walk in your worst holiday sweater along the lake. Race-day registration closes at 9:59 a.m.

events.title: Lights on the Lake
events.blurb: The two-mile drive-thru holiday light show runs nightly through January 4. Tickets must be bought online.

events.title: Gingerbread Gallery
events.blurb: The museum's yearly gingerbread house show runs through January 10. Seniors $10; ages 2 and under free.

events.title: Museum of Science & Technology (MOST)
events.blurb: Hands-on science museum with ExploraDome films, open all holiday weekend.

events.title: Everson Museum of Art
events.blurb: Now showing include America 250: Rebels, Radicals, and Revolutionaries, Sincerely, Beato and New Works in Clay. Seniors and students get in free on Sundays.

events.title: CNY Regional Market
events.blurb: Farmers, bakers and vendors every weekend. Go early for the best pick.
